column1: # MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.67.
# THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE. CM051 VENDORS IT.
# CM051 scripts/sync_cut_bom.sh copies this file into cuts/v1.0.67/ there and
# records the OS003 commit it came from in cuts/BOM_PIN. Authoring it in CM051
# instead produces a copy with no pin, "a fork nobody declared".
# EVERY ROW SAYS ONE OF THREE THINGS AND NEVER A FOURTH
#   gate:<workflow>#<job>   a CI gate that FAILS on the real pre-fix tree
#   artefact:<sha8>#<what>  measured on the published artefact itself
#   needs-walk:<ver>#<what> UNPROVEN, and here is exactly what to look at
# WHY THIS CUT EXISTS, IN ONE LINE
# v1.0.64 was cut, published and verified to its payload, and NEVER WALKED,
# because it still ends a cold-Mac install with a red final step. This cut
# carries ONE defect fix and moves no other variable: the daemon pin is HELD
# at bc63c445, unchanged since v1.0.62.
# THE ROW BELOW IS PROVED BY EXECUTION, NOT BY A PATTERN, AND ON PURPOSE
# The defect is an ORDERING between a guard and a fold, and after v1.0.64's
# partial fix BOTH were present in the tree. Every structural check over the
# source answers YES on a tree that still ships the bug, so a grep-shaped BOM
# row here would be a row that cannot discriminate. The gate named below runs
# the real block against a stub producer and reads the recorded rc.
# TWO PINNED CONTROLS, BOTH REPRODUCING THE FAILURE. Measured 2026-09-04:
#   45126e9a  the v1.0.63 cut, the blob that produced the measured log line
#             -> rc 2 folded, producer ran            DISCRIMINATES
#   deecd9fc  v1.0.64's tree, this fix's own parent
#             -> rc 2 folded, producer ran            DISCRIMINATES
#   subject   this cut, empty owner email
#             -> rc 0 folded, producer NOT run        the fixed behaviour
#   subject   this cut, owner email PRESENT
#             -> rc 2 folded, producer ran            CONTROL on the fix
# The last line is what stops the cheap green: deleting the fold entirely
# would satisfy the third line and hide every real producer failure.
# Pins are fixed shas, never a moving branch. A control that reads origin/main
# inverts the moment the fix it guards merges, and then passes forever.

DECLINING A RE-INSTALL MUST NOT WIPE THE INSTALL ALREADY THERE. Data loss on the decline path: the promote that precedes the decline arm and the arm itself are one flag with opposite guards, so the arm was reachable only when the promote had not run. TNM closed the open question with a proof rather than a sample.

TWO UNMEASURED FLAGS WERE SET AND READ BY NOTHING, so a counter that COULD NOT RUN was published to the customer as a measured zero. The email arm deliberately reports nothing rather than telling a customer to connect an account they already have.

A SUBSHELL MUST NOT EMIT A TERMINAL DONE. A healthy install rendered the failure banner with an ERR-99 code and then carried on, so a DONE status=fail could be overwritten by a later status=ok and the verdict lost.

THE UPGRADE PATH SILENTLY REVERTED THE LAUNCHAGENT HOMEBREW-PATH FIX. launchd gives its jobs a bare PATH unless the plist sets one; the upgrade preserved every env key EXCEPT PATH, so Colima-dependent services were gone after every reboot on an upgraded box.
THE SHIPPING ostler_fda HAS NEVER WRITTEN A USAGE-JOURNAL RECORD. The producer existed and the record did not, so the journal read as an empty history rather than as a producer that never ran.

THE OLLAMA HEALTH ARM MUST NOT DEPEND ON A FOREIGN PORT. MEASURED ON THE v1.0.66 ARTEFACT WALK: another account on the same Mac served :11434, the bare loopback curl answered yes, the only branch that writes com.ostler.ollama.plist was SKIPPED, and health_check reported ok in zero seconds. A CANNOT-RUN WEARING A PASS. The helper now parses the launchd state line, because rc=0 covers both running and loaded-but-dead.

THE SENTINEL VOCABULARY IS DECLARED AND THE DECLARATION IS PROVED BY EXECUTION. Writer and reader had drifted twice in one night (sources 13 vs 9, statuses 5 vs 3), so cannot_run and timeout fell through to 'Could not tell' on the customer's freshness panel. The gate EXECUTES every recorder and asserts what it actually wrote.

A SELF-REMOVING AGENT MUST DELETE ITS PLIST BEFORE IT DIES. Three agents called launchctl bootout on their OWN label before rm -f, and launchd tears the job down before control returns: measured 10/10 on the line before the bootout and 0/10 after it. The surviving plist is re-read at every login, so the agent came back on every reboot for the life of the machine.
